findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Homeomorph/SetCongr.lean:31,41` define `setCongr_apply` and `setCongr_symm_apply`. `Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Lemmas.lean:352` marks `Homeomorph.Set.univ` with `@[simps!]`. The same file already uses `Homeomorph.setCongr_apply` at line 282.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `simp only [realizationRelabelingHomeomorph, Homeomorph.trans_apply, Homeomorph.setCongr_apply, TauCeti.Homeomorph.setCongr_symm_apply, Homeomorph.Set.univ_apply, Homeomorph.Set.univ_symm_apply]`, or with the `symm_trans_apply` variant for the inverse, and drop the unfolding of `Equiv.Set.univ`.
findings.issue: `realizationRelabelingHomeomorph_val` unfolds the definitions `Homeomorph.setCongr, Homeomorph.Set.univ, Equiv.Set.univ` with `dsimp only` and relies on definitional equality through these wrappers. The same problem occurs at line 250 (`realizationRelabelingHomeomorph_symm_val`).

findings.evidence: Both proofs contain `dsimp only [realizationTopHomeomorphFace, Homeomorph.(symm_)trans_apply, Homeomorph.setCongr]`, which unfolds a definition when a dedicated apply lemma exists.
findings.fix: Replace the `Homeomorph.setCongr` unfolding with `Homeomorph.setCongr_apply` or `TauCeti.Homeomorph.setCongr_symm_apply` in a `simp only`, then close with the `realizationRelabelingHomeomorph_(symm_)val` lemma.
findings.issue: `realizationTopHomeomorphFace_val` and `realizationTopHomeomorphFace_symm_val` repeat the same `dsimp only [..., Homeomorph.setCongr]` unfolding of the definition.

summary: Four new `_val`/`_symm_val` proofs use `dsimp only` to unfold the definitions of `Homeomorph.setCongr`, `Homeomorph.Set.univ` and `Equiv.Set.univ`, where existing apply lemmas would do the same job. Otherwise the proofs are short and clear, and the one `change` has a comment explaining it.
